correctness.rationale: Reconstructed zero-sum centered unit vertices, inner product (n|S∩T|-k²)/K and normalized harmonic addition Q3(u)=((n+1)u³-3u)/(n-2). Hence the N×N Gram kernel is a degree-three polynomial of t=|S∩T|. Finite-difference expansion in W_r W_r* and exact eigenvalues binomial(k-j,r-j)binomial(n-r-j,k-r) on U_j give the four claimed rational levels, with m_j=binomial(n,j)-binomial(n,j-1). An independently written SymPy derivation checked all four rational identities symbolically; ten directly constructed rational-entry Gram matrices (n,k)=(5,2),(6,2),(6,3),(7,2),(7,3),(8,2),(8,3),(8,4),(9,3),(10,3) agreed with predicted eigenvalues to 3.2e-15 absolute. λ3>0 when k≥3, λ0 and λ2 vanish exactly when h=0, λ1 vanishes iff n(n+1)=6K; that is (n-1)^2-3h^2=1. Positive Pell solutions satisfying k≥2 start at r=2 with (n,k)=(8,2),(27,6),(98,21),...; at these precisely U1 of dimension n-1 is lost. At n=2k only U1 and U3 survive, including n=6,k=3; for k=2 U3 is absent. Complementary observations count as distinct points. Non-Johnson sectors j≥4 vanish by degree; rank identities and trace-N normalization follow. No higher-degree or stability claim.

value.rationale: Complete fixed-weight vertex orbits of centered hypersimplices are canonical high-symmetry spherical sampling configurations; determining exactly which cubic spherical harmonics can be distinguished is a motivated rank/frame question. The all-parameter four-sector spectrum and a thin infinite Pell set of exactly (n-1)-dimensional losses give a sharp qualitative and arithmetic boundary, including balanced antipodal parity effects. These facts are not merely an arbitrary sample-size table or renaming; they can be used to design/reject cubic interpolation schemes. The theorem correctly disclaims general higher-degree interpolation and dimension-uniform condition numbers.

final_claim: For all integers n≥5, 2≤k≤⌊n/2⌋, degree-three ambient spherical harmonic samples on the normalized centered k-hypersimplex have exactly the displayed four rational Johnson-sector Gram eigenvalues on U0..Umin(k,3), with λ1=0 off the balanced slice exactly at (n-1)^2-3(n-2k)^2=1; the full positive Pell branch starts (8,2),(27,6),(98,21),... and removes the (n-1)-dimensional U1, while n=2k eliminates U0⊕U2 and leaves rank binomial(n,3)-binomial(n,2)+n-1.
scientific_limitations: Only degree-three real homogeneous spherical harmonics on the zero-sum subspace, normalized surface probability and evaluation divided by sqrt(dim H3).
Complete K-subset vertex orbits; no subsampling stability or uniform spectral lower bound.
Arithmetic classification depends on standard Pell solution theory and exact inclusion-matrix decomposition, not finite checks.
Priority remains qualified against differently normalized classical association-scheme specializations.
